paragraphs: Security Operations identified unusual activity associated with an AI-assisted lending customer workflow between approximately 2026-09-20T19:37:40Z and 2026-09-20T19:38:00Z.
Available telemetry suggests external context may have influenced agent behavior and a privileged customer-information tool may have been requested.
Determine what actually occurred, whether unauthorized execution took place, what synthetic data was affected, which controls succeeded or failed, and how the architecture should change.
- affected workflow: AI-assisted lending customer operations; - possible privileged customer-information request; - possible untrusted-context involvement.
Do not assume that every reported stage occurred. Do not assume a scanner finding explains runtime behavior. Do not use unsupported breach language.

blocks.title: Hints from the lab, in the order the lab discloses them
items: HINT_1 (PLANE): Start with runtime tool-control decisions in the incident window; keep external evidence adjacent.
HINT_2 (EVIDENCE_TYPE): Pivot candidate run IDs into memory, MCP authorization, execution, and outcome event families.
HINT_3 (FIELDS): Inspect sequence, event.name, content.hash, memory.id, source_run_id, requested/allowed scope, decision, reason, and operation outcome.
HINT_4 (EXAMPLE_SPL): Run Q-L9-DISCOVER, bind Q-L9-TIMELINE to each candidate, then compare with Q-L9-COMPARE after recording your hypothesis.

spl.name: Q-L9-DISCOVER.spl
spl.text:
index=agentsec_telemetry sourcetype=otel:agentic:json earliest=0 "event.name"=agentsec.control.decision "agentsec.control.id"=CTRL-MCP-001
| eval run_id=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.run.id'),0)
| eval ts=mvindex(mvdedup('timestamp'),0)
| eval tool=mvindex(mvdedup('gen_ai.tool.name'),0)
| eval requested_scope=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.mcp.requested_scope'),0)
| eval allowed_scope=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.mcp.allowed_scope'),0)
| where ts>="2026-09-20T19:37:40Z" AND ts<="2026-09-20T19:38:00Z"
| stats values(tool) AS tools values(requested_scope) AS requested_scopes values(allowed_scope) AS allowed_scopes BY ts, run_id
| sort 0 ts

spl.name: Q-L9-TIMELINE.spl
spl.text:
index=agentsec_telemetry sourcetype=otel:agentic:json earliest=0 "agentsec.run.id"=__RUN_ID__
| eval sequence=tonumber(mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.sequence'),0))
| eval event_name=mvindex(mvdedup('event.name'),0)
| eval plane=case(match(event_name,"rag|context"),"CONTEXT",match(event_name,"memory"),"PERSISTENCE",match(event_name,"control"),"CONTROL",match(event_name,"mcp"),"EXECUTION",true(),"RUNTIME")
| eval control_id=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.control.id'),0)
| eval decision=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.control.decision'),0)
| eval reason=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.control.reason'),0)
| eval tool=mvindex(mvdedup('gen_ai.tool.name'),0)
| eval source_run_id=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.memory.source_run_id'),0)
| eval content_hash=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.content.hash'),0)
| eval attempted=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.operation.attempted'),0)
| eval executed=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.operation.executed'),0)
| eval outcome=coalesce(mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.operation.outcome'),0),mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.outcome'),0))
| table sequence, timestamp, plane, event_name, control_id, decision, reason, tool, source_run_id, content_hash, attempted, executed, outcome
| sort 0 sequence

spl.name: Q-L9-COMPARE.spl
spl.text:
index=agentsec_telemetry sourcetype=otel:agentic:json earliest=0 ("agentsec.run.id"=__ATTACK_RUN_ID__ OR "agentsec.run.id"=__RETEST_RUN_ID__)
| eval run_id=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.run.id'),0)
| eval event_name=mvindex(mvdedup('event.name'),0)
| eval mode=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.testbed.mode'),0)
| eval decision=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.control.decision'),0)
| eval reason=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.control.reason'),0)
| eval content_hash=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.content.hash'),0)
| eval is_started=if(event_name="agentsec.mcp.started",1,0)
| eval is_completed=if(event_name="agentsec.mcp.completed",1,0)
| stats values(mode) AS mode values(decision) AS decisions values(reason) AS reasons values(content_hash) AS hashes max(is_started) AS has_started max(is_completed) AS has_completed dc(_raw) AS distinct_events count AS indexed_rows BY run_id
| eval duplicate_note=if(indexed_rows>distinct_events,"DUPLICATE INDEXED COPIES — NOT ADDITIONAL EXECUTIONS","NO DUPLICATE COPY OBSERVED")
| table mode, run_id, decisions, reasons, hashes, has_started, has_completed, distinct_events, indexed_rows, duplicate_note
| sort 0 mode

spl.name: Q-L9-HUNT.spl
spl.text:
index=agentsec_telemetry sourcetype=otel:agentic:json earliest=-30d
    ("event.name"=agentsec.control.decision OR "event.name"=agentsec.mcp.started OR "event.name"=agentsec.mcp.completed)
| eval run_id=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.run.id'),0)
| eval event_name=mvindex(mvdedup('event.name'),0)
| eval tool=mvindex(mvdedup('gen_ai.tool.name'),0)
| eval requested_scope=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.mcp.requested_scope'),0)
| eval allowed_scope=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.mcp.allowed_scope'),0)
| eval reason=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.control.reason'),0)
| eval started=if(event_name="agentsec.mcp.started",1,0)
| eval completed=if(event_name="agentsec.mcp.completed",1,0)
| stats values(requested_scope) AS requested_scopes values(allowed_scope) AS allowed_scopes values(reason) AS reasons max(started) AS started max(completed) AS completed dc(_raw) AS distinct_events BY run_id, tool
| where mvcount(requested_scopes)>0 AND requested_scopes!=allowed_scopes
| sort 0 - started - completed

spl.name: Q-L9-EXTERNAL-PIVOT.spl
spl.text:
index=agentsec_telemetry earliest=0 (sourcetype=agentsec:scanner:finding OR sourcetype=agentsec:external:evaluation)
| eval evidence_plane=if(sourcetype=="agentsec:scanner:finding","STATIC FINDING","ADVERSARIAL EVALUATION")
| eval external_id=coalesce(mvindex(mvdedup('external.evidence.id'),0),mvindex(mvdedup('run.id'),0))
| eval correlation_method=mvindex(mvdedup('correlation.method'),0)
| eval description_hash=mvindex(mvdedup('artifact.description_sha256'),0)
| eval runtime_run_id=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.run.id'),0)
| table _time, evidence_plane, external_id, correlation_method, description_hash, runtime_run_id, result, severity
| sort 0 _time

spl.name: Q-L9-DETECTION-CANDIDATE.spl
spl.text:
index=agentsec_telemetry sourcetype=otel:agentic:json earliest=0
    ("event.name"=agentsec.control.decision OR "event.name"=agentsec.mcp.started)
| eval run_id=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.run.id'),0)
| eval event_name=mvindex(mvdedup('event.name'),0)
| eval tool=mvindex(mvdedup('gen_ai.tool.name'),0)
| eval requested_scope=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.mcp.requested_scope'),0)
| eval allowed_scope=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.mcp.allowed_scope'),0)
| eval decision=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.control.decision'),0)
| eval is_mismatch=if(requested_scope!="" AND allowed_scope!="" AND requested_scope!=allowed_scope,1,0)
| eval is_started=if(event_name="agentsec.mcp.started",1,0)
| eventstats max(is_mismatch) AS authority_mismatch max(is_started) AS execution_started values(decision) AS decisions BY run_id, tool
| where authority_mismatch=1 AND execution_started=1
| stats values(decisions) AS decisions values(requested_scope) AS requested_scopes values(allowed_scope) AS allowed_scopes dc(_raw) AS distinct_evidence BY run_id, tool
| eval status="DETECTION CANDIDATE — NOT INSTALLED"
